parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.title AS scene_title, s.summary, s.characters_present, s.location, s.time_period, s.emotional_tone, s.word_count, c.chapter_number FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN chapters c ON s.chapter_id = c.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'timeline_verified' ORDER BY c.chapter_number, s.scene_number
SELECT b.bible_type, b.content FROM bibles b WHERE b.project_id = $1 AND b.locked = true
UPDATE scenes SET production_metadata = $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
UPDATE projects SET state = 'planned', total_scenes = $2, estimated_duration_seconds = $3, fight_scenes_count = $4, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'scenes_planned', $2::jsonb, NOW())
